`lame.min.js` is lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), a JavaScript port of
LAME (https://lame.sourceforge.io), used unmodified as a separate file to encode snippets to MP3
in the browser. LAME is licensed under the LGPL.

`three/` is three.js 0.169.0 (https://threejs.org, MIT, see `three/LICENSE`): the core build plus
OrbitControls, RoundedBoxGeometry and RoomEnvironment from its examples, unmodified. Used by the 3D
draw at /management/draw.
